about: Hits of the kernel boundary rules (#12, eslint.config.mjs) each legacy file may still have, per rule. `npm run check:boundaries` fails on a hit no row covers, a count that rises, and a count that falls without its row falling in the same PR. Only `--write-baseline` writes this file; a PR may add a row by hand for a rule #12 defines, with an owner other than #12, removeWhen, and verify. The rules in shrinkOnly (#17's storage access) take no new row and no higher count, except a legacyBlindWrite count that rises by no more than the same file's getStore and objectStore counts fall.
